tool.name: nf-core liftoff
tool.description: Uses Liftoff to accurately map annotations in GFF or GTF between assemblies of the same, or closely-related species
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ if [[ ${target_fa} == *.gz ]]; then zcat ${target_fa} > target.fasta fi
if [[ ${target_fa} != *.gz ]]; then ln -s ${target_fa} target.fasta fi
if [[ ${ref_fa} == *.gz ]]; then zcat ${ref_fa} > reference.fasta fi
if [[ ${ref_fa} != *.gz ]]; then ln -s ${ref_fa} reference.fasta fi
liftoff \\ $arg_g \\ $arg_db \\ -p $task.cpus \\ -o "${prefix}.gff3" \\ -u "${prefix}.unmapped.txt" \\ $args \\ target.fasta \\ reference.fasta
mv \\ "${prefix}.gff3_polished" \\ "${prefix}.polished.gff3" \\ || echo "-polish is absent"
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": liftoff: \$(liftoff --version 2> /dev/null) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Uses Liftoff to accurately map annotations in GFF or GTF between assemblies of the same, or closely-related species
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: liftoff Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/liftoff ]]>
